name: Hive 1.5.8
notes: Root-cause fix for the identity-churn class behind the recent @hive issues. A fresh install creates your workspace under a provisional identity before you sign in; on GitHub sign-in Hive now MIGRATES that provisional self into your account (adds the account at the same role, switches identity, then drops the provisional) instead of leaving a duplicate second 'self' in the roster. That duplicate was what inflated membership and broke solo detection. New installs will never accumulate the duplicate; the 1.5.4-1.5.7 relay-less safeguards remain as defense in depth.
